youtube.title: Why Train Wheels Are Shaped Like Cones 🚂 #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
Railway wheels have a slightly conical tread, wider near the inner flange. On a curve, the train drifts outward so the outer wheel rides on its larger diameter and covers more distance per turn than the inner wheel. This steers the train around the bend by itself, while the flange is a backup guard.
